segments.ja283:1.1: Varaṃ varaṃ tvaṃ nihanaṃ pure cari, asmiṃ padese abhibhuyya sūkare;
segments.ja283:1.3: So dāni eko byapagamma jhāyasi, balaṃ nu te byaggha na cajja vijjati.
segments.ja283:2.1: Ime sudaṃ [imassu tā (syā. ka.)] yanti disodisaṃ pure, bhayaṭṭitā leṇagavesino puthu;
segments.ja283:2.3: Te dāni saṅgamma vasanti ekato, yatthaṭṭhitā duppasahajjame [duppasahajjime (syā.)] mayā.
segments.ja283:3.1: Namatthu saṅghāna samāgatānaṃ, disvā sayaṃ sakhya vadāmi abbhutaṃ;
segments.ja283:3.3: Byagghaṃ migā yattha jiniṃsu dāṭhino, sāmaggiyā dāṭhabalesu muccareti.
